upper_bound.quote:
*Claim:* for every positive integer $t$,
$$t \mid \alpha \ \text{and}\ t \mid \beta
\quad\Longleftrightarrow\quad
t \mid \alpha' \ \text{and}\ t \mid \beta'.$$
(standard; details omitted). In all cases $G_p$ is invariant. $\blacksquare$
upper_bound.witness: The write-up must prove, for every pair of nonnegative valuations—including zero valuations and the case alpha = beta—that the common divisors of (alpha,beta) equal those of (min(alpha,beta),|alpha-beta|). The quoted passage merely asserts this equivalence and explicitly omits its proof.
upper_bound.load_bearing: The claimed invariance of every G_p rests entirely on this unproved equivalence. Without an all-cases proof, the deduction that v_p(M) is fixed by the initial board is not established as written.

parsed.notes: The elementary move description and termination/exactly-one-survivor argument are complete. The displayed formula for M is correct, but its invariance proof defers the essential all-cases gcd argument.
